---
title: "8. ONC Hydrophone Network"
---

Ocean Networks Canada operates a massive spatial array of underwater acoustics monitoring across the country.
Each hydrophone has a designated **Device Code** (ex: ICLISTENHF6016) and is located at a designated **Location code** (ex: CSQH.H1).
The **Location Code** is used by the database, but they also have a **Colloquial Name** (ex: Clayoquot Slope).
In addition, there are two **observatories** VENUS and NEPTUNE, which regroup several sites.

Most locations have a single hydrophone, while some sites have *hydrophone arrays*, which constitutes several hydrophones mounted together on a platform.
The hydrophone arrays naming convention has .H1, .H2, etc., added to the location code, to denote the position of the hydrophone within the array.

### Main locations
* **Pacific:** NEPTUNE (offshore) and VENUS (coastal) observatories.
* **Arctic:** Cambridge Bay, Gascoyne Inlet, NU.
* **Atlantic:** Conception Bay, Holyrood, NL.

# Map of all hydrophone deployments

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

import os, pandas as pd
from onc.onc import ONC
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import geopandas as gpd
import json

# Load ONC cable shapefile
onc_cable_shp_path = '../Instrument_and_cables_shapefiles/ONC_Cables.shp'
onc_cable = gpd.read_file(onc_cable_shp_path)
onc_cable = onc_cable.to_crs("EPSG:4326")

load_dotenv()
onc = ONC(os.getenv("ONC_API_TOKEN"))

# 1. Fetch Deployments
depl = pd.DataFrame(onc.getDeployments({"deviceCategoryCode": "HYDROPHONE"}))

# 2. Prepare Location Names
names_df = pd.read_csv('../notebooks/location_names.txt', 
                       header=None, names=['locationCode','locationName'])

# 3. Merge Names into the main deployment dataframe first
depl = depl.merge(names_df, on='locationCode', how='left')
depl['locationName'] = depl['locationName'].fillna(depl['locationCode'])
depl['siteCode'] = depl['locationCode'].str.split('.').str[0]

def _fmt_date(value):
    if pd.isna(value) or value is None:
        return None
    return pd.to_datetime(value, utc=True).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

site_rows = []
for site_code, group in depl.groupby('siteCode'):
    group = group.sort_values('begin', na_position='last')
    active = group[group['end'].isna()]
    current = active.iloc[-1] if len(active) else group.iloc[-1]
    site_rows.append({
        'siteCode': site_code,
        'locationName': current['locationName'],
        'lat': current['lat'],
        'lon': current['lon'],
        'depth': current['depth'],
        'any_active': len(active) > 0,
        'deviceCode': group['deviceCode'].tolist(),
        'locationCode': group['locationCode'].tolist(),
        'begin': [_fmt_date(v) for v in group['begin']],
        'end': [_fmt_date(v) for v in group['end']],
    })

df_plot = pd.DataFrame(site_rows)

# 4. Pass to OJS
cable_geojson = json.loads(onc_cable.to_json())

ojs_define(
    status_data = df_plot.to_dict(orient='list'),
    cable_data = cable_geojson
)
```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false

L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
html`<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css">`

container = html`<div style="height: 600px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #ddd;"></div>`
yield container;

{
  const map = L.map(container).setView([58, -95], 3);

  L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Ocean/World_Ocean_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
    attribution: 'Esri & Sources',
    maxZoom: 13
  }).addTo(map);

  const inactiveLayer = L.layerGroup();
  const activeLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);

  if (cable_data) {
    L.geoJSON(cable_data, {
      style: {
        color: 'grey',
        weight: 1,
        opacity: 0.7
      }
    }).addTo(map);
  }

  function dateCell(value) {
    return value ? value : "—";
  }

  function deploymentTable(rows, includeEnd) {
    if (!rows.length) return "";
    const head = includeEnd
      ? "<tr><th>Device</th><th>From</th><th>To</th></tr>"
      : "<tr><th>Device</th><th>From</th></tr>";
    const body = rows.map(r => includeEnd
      ? `<tr><td>${r.device}</td><td>${dateCell(r.begin)}</td><td>${dateCell(r.end)}</td></tr>`
      : `<tr><td>${r.device}</td><td>${dateCell(r.begin)}</td></tr>`
    ).join("");
    return `<table class="hydro-popup-table">${head}${body}</table>`;
  }

  status_data.siteCode.forEach((code, i) => {
    const isActive = status_data.any_active[i];
    const color = isActive ? "#28a745" : "#6c757d";
    const cleanName = status_data.locationName[i].replace(/Hydrophone [A-Z]/g, "Hydrophone Array");

    const deployments = status_data.deviceCode[i].map((dev, idx) => ({
      device: dev,
      location: status_data.locationCode[i][idx],
      begin: status_data.begin[i][idx],
      end: status_data.end[i][idx]
    }));

    const activeRows = deployments.filter(d => !d.end);
    const previousRows = deployments.filter(d => d.end).sort((a, b) => (b.end || "").localeCompare(a.end || ""));

    const activeBlock = activeRows.length
      ? `<p class="hydro-popup-heading hydro-popup-current">Current deployments</p>${deploymentTable(activeRows, false)}`
      : `<p class="hydro-popup-heading hydro-popup-previous">No current deployments</p>`;

    const previousBlock = previousRows.length
      ? `<p class="hydro-popup-heading hydro-popup-previous">Previous deployments</p>${deploymentTable(previousRows, true)}`
      : "";

    const depthVal = status_data.depth[i];
    const depth = (depthVal == null || Number.isNaN(Number(depthVal))) ? "—" : `${depthVal} m`;

    const marker = L.circleMarker([status_data.lat[i], status_data.lon[i]], {
      radius: 8,
      fillColor: color,
      color: "white",
      weight: 2,
      fillOpacity: 0.9
    })
    .bindPopup(`
      <div style="font-family: sans-serif; min-width: 360px;">
        <b style="font-size: 1.1em;">${cleanName}</b><br>
        <span style="color: #666; font-size: 0.9em;">${code}</span>
        <hr style="margin: 5px 0;">
        <p style="margin: 5px 0 0 0;"><b>Depth:</b> ${depth}</p>
        ${activeBlock}
        ${previousBlock}
      </div>
    `, { minWidth: 360, maxWidth: 480, maxHeight: 340 });

    if (isActive) {
      marker.addTo(activeLayer);
    } else {
      marker.addTo(inactiveLayer);
    }
  });

  const overlays = {
    "<span style='color: #28a745; font-weight: bold;'>● Current Sites</span>": activeLayer,
    "<span style='color: #6c757d; font-weight: bold;'>○ Inactive Sites</span>": inactiveLayer
  };

  L.control.layers(null, overlays, { collapsed: false }).addTo(map);
}
```


# List of all deployment sites
Here is a list of sites per **location code** and their associated location name, latitude, longitude, depth, and current status.
Click a column header to sort.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# 1. Use 'depl' for the full list (not the grouped df_plot)
# We recreate the 'active_status' column based on 'end' being None
df_full_table = depl.copy()
df_full_table['active_status'] = df_full_table['end'].isna()

# 2. Select the specific columns you want
df_full_table = df_full_table[['locationCode', 'locationName', 'lat', 'lon', 'depth', 'deviceCode', 'active_status']]

# 3. Sort by Name so similar sites are grouped visually
df_full_table = df_full_table.sort_values(['locationName', 'locationCode'])

# formatting depth
df_full_table['depth'] = df_full_table['depth'].apply(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}" if pd.notnull(x) else x)

# 4. Rename for the professional header
df_full_table.columns = ['Location Code', 'Location Name', 'Latitude', 'Longitude', 'Depth (m)', 'Device Code', 'Status']

# 5. Map the boolean to your requested icons
df_full_table['Status'] = df_full_table['Status'].map({True: "🟢", False: "⚪"})

# 6. Display as a clean HTML table
display(HTML(df_full_table.to_html(
    index=False,
    classes='table table-striped table-hover',
    table_id='hydrophone-deployments'
)))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function numericValue(text) {
    const cleaned = text.replace(/[🟢⚪]/g, "").trim();
    if (cleaned === "") return null;
    const n = parseFloat(cleaned);
    return Number.isNaN(n) ? null : n;
  }

  function initSortableTable(table) {
    if (!table || table.dataset.sortable === "1") return;
    table.dataset.sortable = "1";
    const headerRow = table.tHead ? table.tHead.rows[0] : table.rows[0];
    const headers = Array.from(headerRow.cells);
    headers.forEach(function (th, col) {
      th.style.cursor = "pointer";
      th.title = "Click to sort";
      th.addEventListener("click", function () {
        const asc = th.dataset.sort !== "asc";
        headers.forEach(function (h) {
          h.dataset.sort = "";
          const old = h.querySelector(".sort-ind");
          if (old) old.remove();
        });
        th.dataset.sort = asc ? "asc" : "desc";
        const ind = document.createElement("span");
        ind.className = "sort-ind";
        ind.textContent = asc ? " ▲" : " ▼";
        th.appendChild(ind);

        const tbody = table.tBodies[0];
        const rows = Array.from(tbody.rows);
        rows.sort(function (a, b) {
          const A = a.cells[col].textContent.trim();
          const B = b.cells[col].textContent.trim();
          const nA = numericValue(A);
          const nB = numericValue(B);
          let cmp;
          if (nA !== null && nB !== null) {
            cmp = nA - nB;
          } else {
            cmp = A.localeCompare(B, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
          }
          return asc ? cmp : -cmp;
        });
        rows.forEach(function (row) { tbody.appendChild(row); });
      });
    });
  }

  function ready() {
    initSortableTable(document.getElementById("hydrophone-deployments"));
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", ready);
  } else {
    ready();
  }
})();
</script>
```
